text:
You need a WordPress 6.1 CSS template built from existing design artifacts and mock-ups, with a bit of JavaScript, completed under your guidance by March 24, 2023.

I’m Tobias Reyne, with 7 years of full stack experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. In a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves, improving largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s. For Gridbeam Robotics, I built a multilingual documentation site in 4 languages with instant search, and support tickets went down 27%.

I’m comfortable working within an existing team and following your direction closely. What parts of the WordPress build are already defined, and which sections still need CSS or JavaScript decisions?
